title: CometSMPPlugin
body:
CometComm – Harness the Power of Celestial Comets! 🌌☄️

Version: 1.0 | Minecraft 1.21+

Step into the cosmos and claim your destiny with CometComm, the ultimate celestial plugin that brings cosmic powers straight to your Minecraft server! Every player can now summon the might of legendary comets, each granting unique abilities, epic particle effects, and a dynamic progression system that rewards skill and strategy.

✨ Key Features

Random Comet Assignment: Every player receives a unique comet with 3 distinct abilities — roll the stars and see what fate has in store!

Ability Progression: Unlock up to 3 levels per comet using Comet Essence and Comet Upgraders. Level up for stronger powers and flashy new effects.

Epic Cosmic Abilities: From Solar Shields and Stellar Bursts to Veil of Darkness, each comet has its own spectacular abilities with dazzling particles, sound effects, and combat advantages.

Comet Essence System: Collect Comet Essence to unlock or upgrade abilities. Lose essence on death — stay vigilant!

Comet Trader & Upgrader Items: Reroll your comet or boost your level with interactive in-game items like Totems of Undying and Enchanted Books.

Revive Fallen Players: Use Comet Revive Beacons to bring players back from depleted essence — complete with GUI revival system.

Custom Particles & Sound Effects: Every ability is accompanied by cinematic particle effects and sounds for maximum immersion.

Persistent Player Data: All comet data, essence, and levels are saved to a YML file — progress stays across server restarts.

Available Comets

Solar Apex – Harness blazing light and fiery attacks 🌞

Stellar – Summon orbital explosions and cosmic rings ✨

Lunar – Reflect damage and dash through enemies 🌙

Void – Manipulate shadows and collapse surroundings 🖤

Eclipse – Unleash darkness waves and veil enemies 🌌

Crimson – Dash through fire trails and impact foes 🔥

Ward – Protect and blind enemies with warden-like power 🛡️

Why CometComm?

Bring a unique RPG twist to your server with strategic combat, flashy visuals, and endless replayability. Whether you’re defending your realm, dueling other players, or just exploring, CometComm turns every match into a cosmic spectacle.

Installation:

Place the JAR in /plugins.

Start server — use /rollcomets to initialize comet distribution.

Players can check /essence to view their comet stats and abilities.
